name: Gutshof zum Schluxen
beschreibung:
Nestled amid sprawling meadows and pine woodlands near the Bavarian-Tyrolean border, the historic Gutshof zum Schluxen welcomes guests with elegant rooms and refined regional gastronomy.

The royal castles of Neuschwanstein and Hohenschwangau, the Lechweg trail, and the Highline179 bridge are only minutes away.
kurzbeschreibung: Gutshof zum Schluxen in Pinswang offers peaceful seclusion, historic charm, and natural splendour near Reutte.
